description: Set the reverse DNS (PTR) of one IP on a dedicated server — needed for mail delivery and for TLS/SSH banners that must match a hostname. Get the ip from `impreza_dedicated_ips`.

hostname.description: The PTR hostname to publish, e.g. mail.example.com. It should have a matching forward A record.

ip.description: The IP to change, exactly as returned by impreza_dedicated_ips.

name: impreza_dedicated_set_rdns
